ai_summary: **Executive Summary:**  Aditya Birla Capital Limited disclosed its participation in an "Ambit-Daiwa India Access" event in Singapore on August 17, 2026, engaging with 18 prominent global institutional investors and asset managers. This proactive outreach aims to enhance international visibility and potentially attract foreign capital. The company confirmed that no unpublished price-sensitive information was shared and all presentation materials are publicly available, demonstrating transparent investor relations with no apparent red flags.
